text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0}, Mimi, Misogi and Kyoka are on an outing
to the Elven Forest where Kyoka lives.
text_block_list.orig_text:
キョウカが住むエルフの森の周りで遊ぶことにした、
{0}とミミ、ミソギ、キョウカ。

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Wowww! So this is the Elven Forest!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ～！　
ここがエルフの森なんだ～

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Though the Elven Forest is a big place.
The village where I actually live is much further inside.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
エルフの森っていっても広いし、
私が住んでいるのは、
もっともっと奥だけどね。

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
It's all so new and interesting!
You know, I haven't been outside of Landosol much before,
so today is pretty exciting for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おもしろいな～
ミミ、
あんまりランドソルから外にでたことがないんだもん。
今日はちょっとドキドキしてるの～

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
I see {0} is looking around rather curiously, as well.
Although he's pretty much the same even back in Landosol...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さんも物珍しそうですね。
まぁ、
あなたはランドソルの街中でもそんな感じですが……

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
I wonder where Misogi is, though. She's kind of late...
It's already past the time we said we'd meet up...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしてもミソギちゃん、
遅いね～
もう約束の時間過ぎてるのに～

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, Misogi has no concept of a proper schedule!
I expect somebody caught her playing a silly prank,
and she's busy getting lectured right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったく、
ミソギはいつも遅刻ばっかりなんだから！
きっとまた
イタズラしたのが見つかって、
どこかで怒られてるんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure if that would hold her up this long...
You don't think something bad might have happened to her, do you?
Like, um... she got attacked by a monster, or something?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしてもおそすぎるよ……
ミソギちゃん、
もしかしたら、
なにかあったのかな？
たとえば……
魔物におそわれたりとか……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
What...?
D-don't be ridiculous. That couldn't possibly...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……？
そ、
そんなこと、
あるはず……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Graaaaaarghhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi & Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaahhhhhh!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃーーーーーーっ！！！？？？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahah!
You should've seen the looks on your faces!
That was hilarious!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃはははは！
キョウカもミミもすっごい顔ー！！
おもしろーい！！！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Th-that voice! Is that you, Misogi?!
This monster... Don't tell me it's just a costume?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
その声はミソギ！？
この魔物……
もしかして着ぐるみ！？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
'Course it is!
Whewww, that was too much fun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよ～！
あ～、
おもしろかったーー！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Misogi! Not only do you show up late,
but you play a prank to make it worse?!
Why do you always have to pull this kind of stunt?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミソギ！　
遅刻しておいて、
しかもまたイタズラ！？
どうしていっつもこんなことをするの！？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: 'Cause it's funny!
text_block_list.orig_text: おもしろいから！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Urghhh... N-not that again...!
If you keep pulling these ridiculous pranks,
you'll get eaten by a real monster one of these days!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううっ……
ま、
またそれ……！
あんまりイタズラばかりしていると、
そのうち本物の魔物が出てくるよ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Aw, come off it! That's never gonna happen!
Right, Mimi?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことあるわけないじゃーーん！
ねぇ、
ミミ？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUOOOORGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi & Kyoka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: え？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoaaa!
Your costume's even better than mine, Mimi!
Where the heck did you buy it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
す、
すごーい！
ミミの着ぐるみ、
本物みたーい！
どこで買ったの？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Even Mimi is pulling outrageous pranks now?!
That's quite enough, I say!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミまでこんなイタズラをするなんて！
いいかげんにして！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Costume? I didn't bring any costume.
Right, mister?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミ、
きぐるみなんてしらないよ～
ね、
おにいちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Misogi & Kyoka
text_block_list.text: But... Then that means...
text_block_list.orig_text:
と、
いうことは…………

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAAAGGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi & Kyoka
text_block_list.text: I-It's the real thing?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ、
本物っ！！！！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: What do we do?! What do we do?!
text_block_list.orig_text: どうしよう！？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
F-for the moment, we should run!
Misogi, Mimi, {0}, follow me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
と、
とにかく逃げなくちゃ！
ミソギ、
ミミ、{0}さん、
こっち！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Th-this is scary! Waaahhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
こわいよ～！　
うわ～ん！！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Mimi! This is no time to stand around crying!
You need to move!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミ、
泣いてる場合じゃないよ！
あぶないよ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Th-thanks, mister!
text_block_list.orig_text: おにいちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
{0}, watch out!
You need to get out of there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さん、あぶないです！
逃げてください！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: You gotta run too before the monster gets you!
text_block_list.orig_text: にいちゃんも逃げなくちゃダメだよ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Hey, mister?! Are you OK?!
Ahhh! Look, you're bleeding...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にいちゃん！　
大丈夫！？
あ、
血が出てる……！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
A-are you quite all right, {0}?!
You can't try to fight a beast like that on your own!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
大丈夫ですか、{0}さん！？
一人で戦うなんて
無茶です！！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: M-mister...
text_block_list.orig_text: おにいちゃん…………

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: RRRAAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: I'm... not running away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミ、
にげない！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Mimi?!
text_block_list.orig_text: ミミ！？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Nice Guy protected me from the monster...
Now it's my turn to protect him as well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おにいちゃんはミミをかばってくれた……
こんどはミミが、
おにいちゃんをまもるんだもん！！！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
...Nicely said!
I'm not running from that thing either!
We gotta protect Mr. {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうだよ！
ミソギだって、逃げないぞ！
にいちゃんを守るんだ！！！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll join you as well!
Let's protect this big idiot, the three of us together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
私もです！
３人で、
このお人よしさんを守りましょう！！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRROARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi, Misogi & Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Take thiiiiiiis!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: えーーーーーーいっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GGRRRRUOOOGHHHH...
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: ...W-we beat it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………か、
勝った？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
All riiiiight!
We totally did it, you guys! Didja see that, mister?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったー！
ミソギたち、勝ったよ！　
にいちゃん、見てた！？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Th-that was so scary!!!
Waaaaaahhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
こわかったよー！！！
うえーーーーん！！！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
S-something isn't right here...
Even working together, how could the three of us
defeat such a large monster?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
おかしいです……
私たちだけで、
こんな魔物をやっつけられるなんて……

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I did feel like I was stronger than normal...
I was moving around super fast, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミも、
いつもより力がつよくなった気がしたよ？
それに、
はやくうごけた気がしたし……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
...You're saying you used this sword to power up
all of our abilities?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……{0}さんがこの剣で、
私たちを
パワーアップさせたのですか？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea such a thing was possible...
Just who in the world are you, really?
Suspicious doesn't even cover it at this point...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことができるなんて……
あなたはいったい何者なんですか？
もう、
ふしんしゃさんどころではありませんね……

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
But I guess this means it was thanks to you
that we all got out of there safe!
Thanks so much, mister!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもやっぱり
おにいちゃんのおかげで、
ミミたちたすかったんだね！
おにいちゃん、
ありがとー！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, mister!
With you on our side, there's nothing we can't do!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごいよ、にいちゃん！
にいちゃんがいれば百人力だー！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Hey, mister, you gotta keep playing with us!
We'll have the most fun, like, ever!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にいちゃん、
これからもミソギたちと遊んでよ！
絶対おもしろいからさ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Misogi's right!
I want to have all sorts of fun chats with you, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよ～！
ミミ、
いっぱいおにいちゃんとおはなししたい～♪

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
M-Misogi?! Mimi!
What have I told you about trusting this guy too easily?!
Can't you see he's a...
text_block_list.orig_text:
み、
ミソギ！　
ミミ！
あんまり簡単に
気を許しちゃだめだってば！
この人は……

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Can't we see he's... a what?
text_block_list.orig_text:
この人は……
なに～？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: He's... a big idiot... who saved our lives, I guess...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
お人よしの、
命の恩人……
かな？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
That was the day this very little guild
finally welcomed a not-so-little member into its ranks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
子供たち３人の仲良しギルドに一人、
大人の仲間が加わったのだった。
